name: add_block
description: Adds a link button or a social icon to a bio page. Other sections (media, products, tipping, forms) are added in the editor.

name: add_post_comment
description: Adds an internal team comment to a post, as in the post's comment thread. The network never sees it.

name: assign_category
description: Adds categories to posts of the active social set, or removes them.

name: bulk_reschedule
description: Moves several drafts or scheduled posts to new times under one confirmation. Each item succeeds or fails on its own and the result says which; drafts stay drafts.

name: cancel_post
description: Stops a scheduled post from publishing by turning it back into a draft. Nothing is deleted.

name: compare_periods
description: Compares two date ranges of published posts in the active social set, or one channel: posts, engagement, reach, views and the change in percent. Use it for "this month against last month".

name: create_bio_page
description: Creates a link-in-bio page in the active social set with a profile name and bio; links are added with add_block. The page is public at its URL once created.

name: create_category
description: Creates a post category for the workspace.

name: create_collection
description: Creates a media library collection (folder) in the active social set.

name: create_comment_rule
description: Creates a comment rule on a post of the active social set: when a new comment matches the conditions, the inbox replies publicly, sends a DM to the commenter, or hides the comment, with fixed texts or an optional model step. Replies go out without anyone pressing a button, so the member confirms every time. Needs the Influencer plan or higher and a channel whose inbox can reply.

name: create_draft
description: Saves a draft on one channel of the active social set. A draft publishes nothing; it waits in the app until someone schedules it. Needs the member's confirmation unless they allowed drafts.

name: create_draft_from_feed_item
description: Drafts a post sharing a feed item on a channel, with its link, and marks the item used.

name: create_draft_from_idea
description: Turns an idea into a draft on a channel: its caption (or title) and media, with the link appended. The idea is marked Scheduled as in the app.

name: create_evergreen_schedule
description: Makes a post evergreen: Viraly schedules a copy of it every so many days, until a count or a date.

name: create_hashtag_list
description: Saves a hashtag list in the active social set for the composer.

name: create_idea
description: Saves an idea on a board of the active social set.

name: create_short_link
description: Shortens a URL with the workspace's default shortener; the result says if it fell back to Viraly's own.

name: create_social_set
description: Creates a new, empty social set (a brand or client with its own channels, calendar and timezone). Channels are connected to it in the app afterwards.

name: delete_bio_page
description: Deletes a bio page with its custom domain; its URL stops working. The member confirms every time.

name: delete_category
description: Deletes a post category; posts that had it lose it. The member confirms every time.

name: delete_draft
description: Deletes a draft. Undo brings it back as a new draft with the same text, media and time.

name: delete_hashtag_list
description: Deletes a saved hashtag list. The member confirms every time.

name: delete_idea
description: Deletes an idea. Undo saves it again on its board with the same text.

name: delete_media
description: Removes a file from the media library. Posts that already carry it keep it. The member confirms every time.

name: delete_scheduled_post
description: Deletes a scheduled, pending-approval or failed post from Viraly. Irreversible; the member confirms every time. For drafts use delete_draft; to keep a post but stop it, use cancel_post.

name: delete_short_link
description: Deletes a short link. Anyone who opens it afterwards gets nothing, including in posts already published. The member confirms every time.

name: delete_social_set
description: Deletes a social set with all its channels, posts and inbox history. Irreversible; the member confirms on a card every time.

name: disconnect_channel
description: Disconnects a channel from Viraly: its scheduled posts and inbox history are removed. Irreversible; the member confirms on a card every time.

name: duplicate_post
description: Copies a post's text and media into a new draft, on the same channel or another. Works for published and failed posts too.

name: export_analytics_csv
description: Post metrics of a date range as CSV text, one row per published post, up to 100 rows. Hand it to download_file for a file.

name: export_posts
description: The posts of a date range as CSV text (date, channel, status, title, link), up to 100 rows. Hand the text to download_file to give the member a file.

name: export_subscribers
description: A bio page's subscribers as CSV text (name, email, phone, date), up to 100 rows. Hand it to download_file for a file.

name: find_free_slots
description: The empty posting slots of the active social set's channels in a date range, earliest first: each with channel and local time. A slot is empty when no scheduled post sits in it. Use it for "fill the empty slots next week".

name: generate_alt_text
description: Looks at an image in the media library and drafts alt text for it. Returns text; update_alt_text saves it.

name: generate_caption
description: Writes or reworks a caption with the composer's AI assistant: new from a topic, or rephrased, shortened, expanded, more casual or more formal. Returns text only; nothing is saved.

name: generate_hashtags
description: Suggests hashtags for a post with the composer's hashtag generator. Returns text only.

name: generate_ideas
description: Suggests post ideas for a business and audience with the app's idea generator. Returns text; create_idea saves the ones the member likes.

name: generate_image
description: Generates an image with the app's image model and saves it to the media library. It counts against the plan's monthly image allowance, so the member confirms it.

name: generate_link_title
description: Writes a short headline for a link preview or a bio link button.

name: generate_variations
description: Writes alternative versions of a caption, for A/B tests or for posting the same news on several days.

name: get_best_times
description: When the active social set's published posts did best: average engagement by weekday and by local hour over a look-back window, with how many posts each figure rests on.

name: get_bio_analytics
description: A bio page's traffic over a period: views, unique visitors, clicks, click-through rate, bounce rate, and its most clicked links.

name: get_bio_page
description: One bio page: its profile title and bio, its sections, its links (with ids for update_block and remove_block) and its social links.

name: get_calendar
description: The calendar of the active social set for a date range: every post per day with its local time, channel, status and caption start. Use it to see what is planned or where the gaps are.

name: get_category_analytics
description: How each post category performed in the active social set over a date range: posts, reach, impressions, engagement and engagement rate per category, for comparing content pillars.

name: get_channel
description: One channel in detail: platform, account type, status and why (an expired token, a locked channel over the plan's limit), when its token was last refreshed, its posting slots and how many posts it has.

name: get_channel_analytics
description: A channel's performance in a date range: the posts published and their summed metrics on every platform, plus the account's own numbers (followers, reach, engagement) with the previous period of equal length on Facebook and Instagram.

name: get_comment_rule_activity
description: What a comment rule, or a post's rules, did: totals by status and skip reason, and the recent replies, DMs and hides with the text we sent. Commenters' own text is not included.

name: get_custom_domain
description: A bio page's custom domain and its DNS status, with the records the member still has to add at their domain registrar.

name: get_hashtag_list
description: One saved hashtag list in full.

name: get_media
description: One file of the media library: type, status, size, duration, alt text, tags and collection.

name: get_media_requirements
description: Each platform's rules for media and text: formats, file sizes, aspect ratios, video lengths, how many files, caption length and hashtag limits. Check them before drafting; validate_post checks a concrete post.

name: get_post
description: One post of the active social set: the full caption, channel, status, local scheduled time, public link, last error and summary metrics.

name: get_post_analytics
description: What one post of the active social set did: reach, impressions, views, likes, comments, shares, saves, clicks and when the numbers were last updated.

name: get_post_diagnostics
description: Why a post failed or is stuck: the network's error with its reason and hint, the channel's state, and what usually fixes it.

name: get_post_insights
description: The published posts of one channel since a date with their metrics, newest first or ranked by engagement, reach or views.

name: get_post_preview
description: How a post will appear: the full text with its length against the platform's limit, the media in order with type and size, the placement and the local time.

name: get_posting_slots
description: The weekly posting slots of each channel (day and local time) that the queue fills. find_free_slots says which of them are empty on given dates.

name: get_reconnect_link
description: Where the member reconnects an expired or broken channel. Reconnecting needs the member to sign in to the network themselves, so Copilot cannot do it; it can open the page with navigate.

name: get_short_link_stats
description: Clicks on one short link: total, by day, by country, by device and the posts that carry it.

name: get_shortener_settings
description: Which shortener the workspace uses by default (Viraly's own, Bitly, Dub or Rebrandly) and its default domain.

name: get_social_set
description: The active social set in detail: name, short code, colour, timezone and each connected channel with its status.

name: get_url_preview
description: What a link shows when shared: its page title, description, site and image.

name: get_workspace
description: The workspace and the active social set: names, plan, timezone and how many channels are connected. Use it for questions about the account itself. For the workspace's settings (notifications, API keys, connected apps, webhooks, Slack, Teams, Discord) use get_workspace_settings and its neighbours in the settings module.

name: get_workspace_brief
description: The brief the members wrote for Copilot: brand voice, audience, do and don't lists, posting rules. The social set's own brief when it has one, otherwise the workspace's.

name: import_media
description: Imports a file from Dropbox or Unsplash into the active social set's media library. It runs in the background; the result gives the job's state.

name: list_bio_integrations
description: The email-list integrations (for example AWeber, HubSpot, Kit) the active social set's bio pages can send new subscribers to.

name: list_bio_pages
description: The link-in-bio pages of the active social set: id, title, URL slug and custom domain.

name: list_categories
description: The workspace's post categories (content pillars such as Promotions or Tips) with id, colour and how many posts use each.

name: list_channels
description: The connected accounts and pages of the active social set: id, name, username, platform and status (Active, Expired, Disabled, Locked). Use it to turn a channel name into its id.

name: list_comment_rules
description: The comment rules of the active social set, or of one post: id, post, what triggers them, what they do, status and what they did in the last 30 days.

name: list_evergreen_schedules
description: The evergreen schedules of the active social set: which post recycles, how often, how many times so far and whether it is paused.

name: list_feed_items
description: The newest items of a feed: title, link, summary and whether they were used.

name: list_feeds
description: The RSS and Atom feeds the active social set follows, with unread item counts and fetch errors.

name: list_hashtag_lists
description: The saved hashtag lists of the active social set: id, topic and the hashtags.

name: list_idea_boards
description: The idea boards of the active social set with how many ideas each holds.

name: list_ideas
description: The ideas on one board: title, caption, notes, link, planned date and status.

name: list_media
description: Files in one media library collection of the active social set, 25 per page, newest first: id, type, size, alt text and tags. Use the ids as mediaIds in posts.

name: list_media_collections
description: The media library's collections (folders) in the active social set, with how many files each holds.

name: list_pending_approvals
description: Posts of the active social set in the approval workflow: by default the ones waiting for this member to approve, with channel, local time and caption start.

name: list_pinterest_boards
description: The boards of a Pinterest channel, with their ids. A pin needs a board.

name: list_post_comments
description: The team's internal comments on a post (not comments from the network), oldest first, with who wrote them.

name: list_posts
description: Posts of the active social set, 25 per page, latest scheduled first: id, a short caption, channel, status, local scheduled time and summary metrics. For one post in full use get_post; for the best performers use list_top_posts; for posts waiting for the member's approval use list_pending_approvals (approvals module), which knows who approves what.

name: list_recycled_content
description: The copies an evergreen post has produced so far: each copy's time and status.

name: list_short_links
description: The workspace's short links, 25 per page, newest first: short URL, original URL, clicks and the shortener that made it.

name: list_social_sets
description: The social sets this member can open, with name, short code and timezone, and which one is active. Tools work on the active set; to act on another one the member named, pass its id as socialSetId.

name: list_subscribers
description: People who signed up on a bio page's email form, newest first: name, email and date; at most 25, with the total.

name: list_timezones
description: Timezone ids the app accepts, for setting a social set's timezone. Filter with search; at most 50 come back.

name: list_top_posts
description: The best performing published posts of the active social set in a date range, across its channels, with summary metrics. Use it for questions like "what was my best post this week".

name: move_media
description: Moves files to another collection of the same social set.

name: move_to_queue
description: Puts a draft or scheduled post into its channel's next empty posting slot; it then publishes by itself at that time.

name: pause_comment_rule
description: Pauses a comment rule, or every rule of a post, so no more replies go out; or resumes them. Undo puts the rules back as they were.

name: pause_evergreen_schedule
description: Pauses an evergreen schedule so no new copies are made, or resumes it.

name: publish_now
description: Publishes a draft or scheduled post to the network right now. Irreversible: once on the network Viraly cannot take it back. The member confirms on a card every time.

name: remove_block
description: Removes a link button or a social icon from a bio page.

name: request_approval
description: Sends a post for approval: it waits as Pending approval and does not publish until approved. The approvers are notified as in the app.

name: request_custom_domain
description: Starts serving a bio page on the member's own domain. It returns the DNS records the member must add at their registrar; the domain works once they are in place.

name: request_media_render
description: Makes an edited copy of a library file on the server: a centred crop to an aspect ratio, a video trim, or both. The original stays; the copy appears in the library when the render finishes.

name: reschedule_post
description: Moves a draft, scheduled or pending-approval post of the active social set to a new time. A draft keeps its status: it gets the time but stays a draft and does not publish until someone schedules it. Needs the member's confirmation unless they allowed rescheduling.

name: retry_failed_post
description: Tries a failed post again right now. Read get_post (its error) or get_post_diagnostics first: retrying an expired channel or a rejected file fails again.

name: rewrite_for_channel
description: Rewrites a caption for another platform's length and style, for example a LinkedIn post into a Bluesky one under 300 characters.

name: schedule_post
description: Schedules a post to publish by itself at a time, or in the channel's next queue slot: a new post, or an existing draft. It publishes without anyone pressing a button, so check it with validate_post first.

name: search_media
description: Searches every collection of the active social set's media library by file name, alt text or tag; at most 25 results.

name: search_posts
description: Finds posts of the active social set by words in their text, newest first, among its latest 2,000 posts. Use it to find "the post about the autumn guide".

name: set_default_shortener
description: Chooses which shortener the workspace uses by default.

name: set_posting_slots
description: Replaces one channel's weekly posting slots. Queued posts move to the new slots as the app does when slots are edited.

name: subscribe_feed
description: Follows an RSS or Atom feed in the active social set so its items appear in Feeds.

name: trigger_analytics_sync
description: Asks the network for a channel's latest numbers now instead of waiting for the next scheduled fetch. It runs in the background for a few minutes.

name: unsubscribe_feed
description: Stops following a feed and removes its items. Undo follows it again; read states start over.

name: update_alt_text
description: Sets a library file's alt text, which posts carry to the networks that support it. generate_alt_text drafts one.

name: update_bio_page
description: Changes a bio page's profile name, bio or URL slug. Design and other sections are edited in the app.

name: update_block
description: Changes a link button's text or URL, or a social icon's URL, on a bio page.

name: update_category
description: Renames or recolours a post category.

name: update_evergreen_schedule
description: Changes how often an evergreen post recycles and when it stops.

name: update_hashtag_list
description: Changes a saved hashtag list's topic or hashtags.

name: update_idea
description: Changes an idea's title, caption, notes, status or date.

name: update_post
description: Changes the text, media or placement of a draft or scheduled post. It keeps its status and time; use reschedule_post for the time.

name: update_social_set
description: Renames the active social set or changes its timezone.

name: update_workspace_brief
description: Replaces the brief Copilot reads on every request (brand voice, audience, rules), for the whole workspace or this social set only. Show the member the new text; it replaces the old one.

name: upload_media_from_url
description: Adds a file to the active social set's media library from a public link. The server downloads and measures it; the result says when it is ready to post.

name: validate_post
description: Checks a post before it is saved or scheduled, with the same rules the app enforces: caption length, media formats, sizes, counts and aspect ratios per platform, plus a channel that cannot publish, a time in the past and the same text already on the channel. Returns each problem; saves nothing.
